_about: Public-domain Randolph Harrison McKim (1842-1920), rector of the Church of the Epiphany, Washington, for the Word Hoard: his theology and sermons only: The Doctrine of the Church of England as to the Christian Ministry, Future Punishment, Bread in the Desert, Christ and Modern Unbelief, Leo XIII at the Bar of History, Present-Day Problems of Christian Thought, The Gospel in the Christian Year, The Problem of the Pentateuch, The Proposal to Change the Name of the Protestant Episcopal Church, Romanism in the Light of History, For God and Country, his history of Christ Church, Alexandria, and single sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 91 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
